text:
alana (marketing): Quick kickoff: FluxRelay Starter Kit (OSS mini-refapp + 15m tutorial). Plan: short blog, gated demo webinar, reproducible benchmark gist, and a 60s social highlight. Target: two weeks. Need bench framing, webinar hook, RSVP routing, and who owns what.

 drew (devrel): Love the name. Benchmark story idea: pick a single customer scenario (multi-turn customer assist, seq=160) and show cold vs warmed KV cache. Show p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens with one clear takeaway per chart.

 paul (growth): RSVP gating: single-select "Your primary focus" -> (prototype / product / infra). Route to /workflows/fluxrelay-webinar and tag leads `fluxrelay_rsvp`. Add utm_source per social channel.

 rachel (engineer): Repo's ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/fluxrelay-starter. Bench command for demo: `./bench/flux_bench.sh --concurrency 16 --seq 160 --save /tmp/flux_report.json`. We'll upload to S3: `aws s3 cp /tmp/flux_report.json s3://redwood-flux/reports/`. Sample report snippet: {"p50_ms": 30, "p95_ms": 85, "cost_per_1k": "$0.08"}.

 toni (events): Webinar format: 30m total (12m demo, 8m benchmark walkthrough, 10m live Q&A). Wed 9am PT preferred. We'll record a 60s highlight during rehearsal for socials.

 site-bot: Staging preview deployed: https://fluxrelay-preview.redwood.ai  build #614 passed :white_check_mark:

 drew (devrel): Draft copy: Blog blurb: "FluxRelay Starter Kit: clone, run a reproducible benchmark, and tune for latency & cost in 15 minutes. Includes Docker and k8s manifests." Social: "FluxRelay Starter Kit  15m OSS walkthrough + reproducible benchmark. Demo Wed 9am PT. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/fluxrelay (utm=tw)"

 alana (marketing): Good. Add "benchmark reproducibility" explicitly on social short. Also add CTA in blog: "Run the benchmark yourself."

 paul (growth): Post-webinar routing: immediate email (repo + report link) + segmented follow-up by track at 48h. A/B subject lines for post-email: A) "Your FluxRelay benchmark & starter kit" B) "See how we hit 30ms p50  FluxRelay results". I'll run 50/50.

 rachel (engineer): Note: numbers vary by instance; we'll append a mini table: dev (g5) vs prod (a100) expected ranges. Also include the exact bench command in the report for reproducibility.

 drew (devrel): For the demo, I'll show caching warm-up (cold -> warm) with three short prompts so we can illustrate batching & cache benefits. I'll record a 60s clip during rehearsal.

 toni (events): Ops checklist: 1) landing page + RSVP form 2) slides + rehearsal 3) 60s social highlight 4) UTMs + tracking 5) infra on-call. Who owns slides?

 alana (marketing): I'll own slides & blog. drew owns demo script + social clips. paul owns registration funnel & tags. rachel infra on-call + report format. toni events ops.

 paul (growth): Quick tracking ask: add campaign param `utm_campaign=fluxrelay_launch` and separate `utm_content` per social clip variant. Also tag RSVPs with `fluxrelay_webinar_rsvp`.

 rachel (engineer): We'll ensure bench outputs both CSV and JSON. Example JSON snippet for email attachment: {"p50_ms":"30","p95_ms":"85","cost_per_1k":"$0.08","instance":"g5.x/8"}.

 drew (devrel): One more ask: can we A/B two landing page CTAs: A) "Get the starter kit & results" B) "Clone the repo & see the benchmark"? Small test 50/50.

 alana (marketing): Yes, Paul please run that test. Also let's A/B two post-webinar subject lines as Paul suggested.

 site-bot: Calendar event created: 2026-08-FLUX-01. Reminder scheduled for speakers.

 toni (events): Rehearsal scheduled Tues (one day before), 30m. Please confirm availability.

 alana (marketing): Confirmed. Final note: include a short CTA in the demo asking attendees to "run the benchmark yourself" so the immediate post-webinar email has high conversion. Thanks! :rocket:
